contracts.scope: full-width checked record extents and actual 32-byte native header/footer producer-consumer pairs
contracts.limits: Framing scalars retain their full Rust ranges. Header physical end must fit u64; present footer links must be nonzero and backward. Fixed framing loops are bounded, with unwinding assertions enabled. Does not prove whole-file, payload-codec, filesystem or foreign-compression correctness.

specification.requires: Valid Rust scalars. Header offset + header length + payload length + footer length fits u64. Each present footer predecessor is nonzero and less than the record offset. Slice I/O uses the standard-library model.
specification.ensures: Checked extents match independent u128 arithmetic. Actual native header/footer encoders match fixed wire positions and little-endian bytes independently of the shared role table. Their paired decoders accept those bytes with every field unchanged and consume exactly the 32-byte header.
specification.on_error: Checked extent overflow returns an error. The producer-consumer harnesses cover the stated successful-input domain, not arbitrary malformed input.
specification.frame: Encoding/decoding changes only the supplied fixed framing buffer/cursor, not payload bytes or published file state.
specification.progress: Fixed 32-byte framing, independent of declared payload length and file record count.

contracts.scope: full-width inductive range/observation transition; truncation up to four rows; four-row u16 membership
contracts.limits: General count*stride representation induction timed out and is not proved; internal row indices must be representable. No whole-caller refinement.

specification.requires: Reachable prefix invariant and representable private row indices.
specification.ensures: Observed membership is never invented; truncation removes only rows.
specification.on_error: Unrepresentable or irregular observations do not establish a new prefix.
specification.progress: Observation advances monotonically; bounded truncation checks at most four rows.

contracts.scope: full-width typed metadata; actual 24-byte frontier wire decoder and exhaustion flag
contracts.limits: Complete metadata byte parsing and OS ordering excluded; the 24-byte frontier decoder is included

specification.requires: Typed metadata values; the frontier wire input has exactly 24 bytes.
specification.ensures: Accepted metadata obeys confirmed/published/checkpoint frontier relations; exhausted wire sequence must be zero.
specification.on_error: Invalid frontiers are rejected before checkpoint/publication.
specification.frame: Validation and wire decoding do not mutate published state.
specification.progress: Finite field checks, independent of declared record count.

contracts.scope: abstract I/O effects and inductive frontiers
contracts.limits: Callbacks, fsync durability and stable snapshots assumed; creation/replacement not modeled

specification.requires: Returning I/O callbacks obey the stated effect model; confirmed snapshots are stable.
specification.ensures: Acknowledgment follows the required data/head/checkpoint durability steps.
specification.on_error: A failed transition preserves reader state or poisons the writer as specified.
specification.frame: Confirmed frontiers are not changed by failed publications.
specification.progress: Finite protocol transitions; OS liveness/durability is assumed.

contracts.limits: C zstd decoding/workspace and legacy parsing excluded

specification.requires: Unsigned fields may be arbitrary; valid Rust scalar values.
specification.ensures: Output requests obey both bounds; accepted block/stream steps stay inside input and output extents.
specification.on_error: Invalid or non-progressing steps return None.
specification.frame: Pure decisions do not change buffers or backend state.
specification.progress: Every accepted streaming step strictly decreases remaining input+output; a block advances its input offset.

contracts.scope: full-width offsets, at most four bytes and one Interrupted
contracts.limits: Write returns n <= requested; unending Interrupted and OS liveness excluded

specification.requires: Write returns n<=requested, callbacks return; bounded model has at most one Interrupted.
specification.ensures: Position reflects every accepted partial write and never exceeds the optional capacity.
specification.on_error: No write is issued past the capacity; errors preserve completed progress for retry.
specification.frame: Unwritten bytes and unrelated state remain unchanged.
specification.progress: Each positive write consumes input; unending Interrupted is excluded.

contracts.scope: full-width actual table extent plus arbitrary header fields and entry bytes; complete 49-byte one-entry validator positive witness, frame checks disabled; executable table contract and actual short-table consumer composition with arbitrary u64 total/u32 count
contracts.limits: Whole 0..96-byte parser attempts timed out. Loop count derives from validated actual input extent; complete raw parser covered by native corpus/fuzzing, not a whole-parser proof.

specification.requires: Valid byte slice; structural-only composition disables C frame decoding.
specification.ensures: Accepted table extent equals 32+16*count within actual input; empty complete container is accepted.
specification.on_error: Incomplete tables are rejected before entry reads or allocations, with 0..32 real input bytes, chunk size 1 and arbitrary u64 total/u32 count.
specification.frame: Header/table checks do not mutate input; the composed rejection path allocates nothing.
specification.progress: Table count is bounded by actual input; this is not a whole arbitrary-size parser proof.

contracts.scope: full-width inductive budget step; actual MaterializationBudget::decode twice across short input, callback errors and retry
contracts.limits: Budget reset requires prior record release; not a whole-process live-memory bound

specification.requires: 0<=remaining<=limit; returning codecs read/charge through Decoder and do not manipulate its private state.
specification.ensures: Accepted charges decrease the shared ledger exactly; retained sibling decodes and retry use the same remainder.
specification.on_error: Short reads, callback rejection and trailing bytes do not refund completed charges.
specification.frame: Limit is unchanged; reset is used only after prior retained values are released.
specification.progress: Each admitted count is bounded by the finite work/materialization budget.

contracts.limits: Binding guard plus real CRC-valid hostile index tests; callbacks and node parser not formally refined

specification.requires: Valid mutable fuel reference; unsigned values may be arbitrary.
specification.ensures: Accepted visit consumes exactly one fuel unit; an accepted child matches expected height.
specification.on_error: Zero fuel rejects and remains zero; mismatched height rejects.
specification.frame: Only the declared fuel location may change; height matching is pure.
specification.progress: Accepted recursive child height is strictly lower; finite visit fuel decreases.

contracts.scope: full-width charge/count arithmetic; 64-byte cursor/preflight input; actual nested/accounted transfer with a returning charged callback; two-table HashMap reservation accounting; actual complete Vec<u8> decode, arbitrary u64 declared length/budget, at most4 payload bytes and symbolic reservation refusal; actual nested two-stage charged callback with 0..18 input bytes, both endians and unchanged parent frame; root callback numeric havoc and active safe-primitive induction over four-byte backing, full-width cursor/budget and changed scope/input identities; collection preflight exhaustively partitions wire width into zero, 1..64 and >64 with the same full-width count/entry/budget and u128 oracle
contracts.limits: BTreeMap excluded. Does not model actual allocator/hashbrown/C allocation or arbitrary custom-code allocation/termination. Numeric callback effects are separately over-approximated; safe active-frame mutation also relies on Rust privacy/lifetimes and the structural closure gate. Hash table layout bound assumes the documented supported std layout. No global process OOM claim. Caller decode proof assumes a contract-obeying allocator and the independently checked standard empty-Vec model; it does not model arbitrary T. Unqualified allocated-String experiments are excluded: verifier timeout/memory exhaustion is not a library OOM or a successful proof.

specification.requires: Reachable cursor/budget invariant and a returning callback. Budget-to-allocation claims require custom allocation to use the read/charge interface and a Rust-contract-obeying allocator.
specification.ensures: Byte decode allocates only for input- and budget-admitted lengths; complete byte results consume exactly the supplied input. Root callback admission cannot expand budget, retreat/escape cursor or replace frame identity; an active safe read/charge/replacement step preserves the invariant or rejects.
specification.on_error: Byte reservation refusal and short input return errors; two-stage callback failures, short reads and trailing bytes do not refund completed charges. Invalid replacement is rejected with exhausted authority; callback unwind is checked separately by native tests.
specification.frame: Nested decode preserves parent input/cursor/limit; only its remaining budget is transferred back on both outcomes. Callback admission retains original input identity, endian and limit.
specification.progress: Length/count arithmetic is full-width; actual byte decode payload is bounded to four bytes; two-stage callback input is at most 18 bytes.

contracts.scope: Actual Box/clone/private Arc helpers; symbolic allocation refusal; full-width raw u16 reservation requests; byte vectors <=4 elements and ASCII strings <=4 bytes, nested boxed clones <=3 elements, COW vector of 3 bytes; single-threaded refcounts
contracts.limits: Allocator obeys Rust contract and returns null on refusal. User initializers/TryClone/Drop return normally and satisfy contracts. No universal proof of arbitrary T, container size, concurrency, refcount overflow, OS termination or stack space. Returned heap-free errors are forgotten at caller boundary; payload and partial-owner drops execute. Kani 0.68 RawVec::new_in layout problem requires an explicit standard empty-Vec constructor model, independently checked; fresh clone growth is forbidden by the allocator model.

specification.requires: Allocator obeys Rust allocation contract; initializer/TryClone/Drop return normally with valid values.
specification.ensures: Successful construction/clone has the stated unique/shared ownership and payload.
specification.on_error: Refusal preserves the source and drops partial owners; initializer is not called before reservation.
specification.frame: Existing source ownership and payload remain valid.
specification.progress: Bounded payload/clone models; no arbitrary-T or complete initialization proof.

contracts.scope: Actual u32 Box construction and boxed TryClone success; complete allocator refusal before callback.
contracts.limits: No arbitrary-T, Arc, partial multi-allocation failure or global OOM claim. Extra validity checks cover both harnesses; extra uninit checks cover refusal only. Successful Box::write is unsupported by uninit instrumentation (raw pointer/union). Success uses normal Kani allocation models; refusal returns null. Heap-free error is forgotten at caller boundary.

specification.requires: Selected u32 value and contract-obeying allocator; refusal returns null.
specification.ensures: Selected scalar construction/clone passes value-validity instrumentation.
specification.frame: No uninitialized successful Box::write is claimed under unsupported instrumentation.
specification.progress: Selected scalar cases only; complete owner initialization belongs to the separate library.

contracts.scope: full-width indices and arbitrary first row, up to39 backing bytes and13-byte rows
contracts.limits: No filesystem, allocation or whole-owner initialization model

specification.requires: Nonzero fixed row width; backing window has at most 39 bytes for 13-byte rows.
specification.ensures: Returned row agrees exactly with the private resident window.
specification.frame: Backing bytes and unrelated indices remain unchanged.
specification.progress: Finite index/extent arithmetic; no filesystem model.

contracts.scope: full-width u64 sequence subtraction and usize candidate conversion
contracts.limits: Candidate arithmetic only. Membership requires the actual private offset comparison. No filesystem/allocation model.

specification.ensures: Candidate equals the wide nonnegative sequence difference exactly when representable.
specification.on_error: Underflow or usize overflow returns no candidate.
specification.frame: No private row/offset proof is synthesized from a sequence candidate alone.
specification.progress: One subtraction/conversion step; membership still requires the real offset comparison.

contracts.scope: Full-width scalar transition contracts, independent of physical input/container length
contracts.limits: Actual storage/callback binding is checked separately; no allocator or OS model

specification.requires: Valid unsigned values, booleans and optional shared byte references; no assumed file validity.
specification.ensures: Charges and cursor steps return exactly the admitted state; callback exit requires origin, bounded cursor and non-increasing budget.
specification.on_error: Rejected transitions have no committed state.
specification.progress: Successful nonzero charge/read strictly reduces its remaining extent.
